reasoning_content: The build is running in the background. This could take several minutes. Let me wait and then check the logs.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time

client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

print("Waiting for build...")
time.sleep(60)

# Check if container is running now
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("docker ps 2>&1")
print("Containers:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check logs
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -20 /tmp/docker-build.log 2>&1")
print("Log:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
